testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hides the Parameters panel during sketch editing: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:625:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hides the Parameters panel during sketch editing ✔ Given a part document is in sketch edit in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Sketch tab is active ✔ And the Parameters panel is hidden ✔ When the user opens the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ Then Parameters is unchecked in the panel list ✔ When the user selects Parameters ✔ Then the Parameters panel appears after Format and before Exit ✔ And the panel displays a large parameter symbol ✔ When the user opens the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ And the user selects Parameters ✔ Then the Parameters panel is hidden again ✔ And the sketch remains in edit mode
